tasks.title: Accept priority field on purchase events (mobile 4.2)

declaration.objective: Mobile 4.2's purchase events carrying a priority field are no longer dropped by the v1 validator

criteria.statement: Events with priority of low, normal, or high are accepted
Any other priority value is rejected with InvalidEvent
All other validation behaviour is unchanged
Regression tests for priority are added

execution_fit.choice: NOT_FIT: Implementing the requested change would edit/extend the frozen v1 event contract without required API council approval
execution_fit.rationale: criteria: understood (accept priority in {low,normal,high}, reject other values, no regression, add tests); capability: the code change itself is trivial (one enum field in the schema plus validator already generic over schema properties); hardest: schema/v1/event.schema.json is explicitly marked FROZEN in the file and docs/CHANGE_POLICY.md, which requires any new field to ship as schema/v2 with a written, two-signature API council approval recorded under approvals/, and states validate.py must accept exactly what schema/v1 describes with no special-casing; approvals/README.md confirms no approvals are pending, so no v2 approval exists; evidence: I can prove current behavior (priority rejected) and could prove a hypothetical fix works, but I cannot obtain the required API council approval myself; not authorised/equipped: I must not edit schema/v1, must not add special-case handling in validate.py to accept an unschematized field, and must not author or backdate an approvals/ record on the council's behalf; docs/CHANGE_POLICY.md explicitly says contributors and agents cannot grant approval and must stop and ask; stop if: the fix requires touching schema/v1 or bypassing the approval gate, which it does

blockers.description: Cannot accept the new priority field without a recorded API council approval and a schema/v2 contract per docs/CHANGE_POLICY.md; approvals/ currently has no entries. Needs a human: (1) get two of {M. Okafor, J. Lindqvist, R. Tanaka} to review and sign an approvals/<YYYY-MM-DD>-priority-field.md, (2) publish schema/v2/event.schema.json with the priority enum (low|normal|high), (3) migrate/notify the 12 downstream consumers before v2 events are emitted. Only then can validate.py (or a v2-aware equivalent) be safely changed.
